Special Features
•	Detached family residence in countryside setting.
•	Excellent potential to refurbish and create a lifestyle to match.
•	Gravel driveway adds to the country charm of the property adding to the special feel the house holds. 
•	Spacious open-plan kitchen/dining room that holds a charm of times past
•	Two generous first-floor bedrooms, 1 ground-floor bedroom 
•	Separate bathroom and WC 
•	Flexible second reception room or fourth bedroom 
•	Excellent potential to remodel and revive and create your own space 
•	Beautiful mature landscaped gardens, peaceful countryside setting 

Fran Grincell Properties are delighted to bring to the market Anisa, a charming detached family home set on beautifully mature gardens in the highly sought-after area of Warrington, just a short drive from Kilkenny City, in a peaceful countryside setting that adds to Anisa’s special charm and calm appeal. This spacious residence offers an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking a home with character, generous accommodation and outstanding potential. Warrington is a popular residential location on the outskirts of Kilkenny City, offering the perfect balance of rural tranquillity and urban convenience. 
Extending to approximately 1,082 sq. ft. (100.5 sq. m.), the accommodation has been well maintained throughout and retains much of its original features. There is a sense of nostalgia and ‘olde worlde’ charm about this entire property. While the property would benefit from cosmetic modernisation, it offers an excellent canvas for a purchaser wishing to create a stylish family home in a special setting.
A welcoming entrance hall leads to a spacious open-plan kitchen and dining room, forming the heart of the home. Filled with natural light, this generous space offers excellent potential, whilst recognising the charm and quirkiness of the space adds to its difference.
To the front of the property is a comfortable living room, while a second reception room provides excellent flexibility and could serve as a fourth bedroom, home office, playroom or additional sitting room depending on individual requirements.
A rear hallway gives access to the family bathroom, separate WC and a useful rear entrance.
Upstairs, the accommodation comprises two generously proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom enjoys fitted wardrobes and a vanity area with wash hand basin, while the remaining bedroom is bright, spacious and perfectly suited for family living or guests.
Outside, Anisa is surrounded by mature gardens that have been lovingly cultivated over many years. The grounds feature a large stonewall to the front, established trees, flowering shrubs, gravel pathways, rockeries and a raised decked seating area, creating a peaceful outdoor setting with excellent privacy. A greenhouse and extensive planting areas will particularly appeal to gardening enthusiasts, while the generous site offers ample space for families to enjoy.

Location is key, and it doesn’t get much better than Warrington. The property's mature setting, combined with its excellent location and flexible accommodation, presents an exciting opportunity for buyers seeking a home that can be enhanced over time to create a truly special family residence.
